_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Sending your request to a licensed agent…

description: Sends the customer's chosen option(s) to Libertas's licensed team as a bind request and returns a secure checkout link on Libertas's site. This is a request, not a purchase: no payment is taken and no coverage starts from this call. A licensed agent verifies underwriting, collects payment on the secure page, and confirms coverage with the carrier, and the customer can change or cancel before then. Appropriate once the customer clearly picks an option (for example "I'll take Home Carrier A"); pay_plan is required when an auto option is included.

best_time.description: Best time to reach the customer, e.g. 'weekday afternoons'.

contact_pref.description: How the customer prefers to be reached: 'call', 'text', or 'email'.

customer_notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the customer for the agent.

option_id.description: The single option to bind (or use option_ids for a bundle/split).

option_ids.description: Multi-option bind. Either option_id or option_ids must be provided.

pay_plan.description: Pay plan: 'monthly_eft' or 'pay_in_full' (required when an auto line is included).

water_selections.description: Customer-selected water-coverage add-ons for home options (service line, water seepage, foundation water, sewer backup); the agent configures these at the carrier portal at bind.

name: request_bind_inline

outputSchema.description: Files a routed bind request to the matched agency and returns a bind link.

title: Request to bind
